mcqs.question: The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024, which came into force on June 21, 2024, is administered by which Ministry?
options: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
mcqs.explanation: The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024, is administered by the Ministry of Personnel. The Ministry of Home Affairs is a tempting alternative because it handles several internal security matters, but it is not the ministry identified for administering this Act.

mcqs.question: According to the ADR report on the declared assets of sitting Chief Ministers, what was the average value of assets?
mcqs.explanation: The average declared assets of the sitting Chief Ministers were ₹118.07 crore. ₹1,413 crore refers to the assets of the wealthiest Chief Minister identified in the report, not the average.
